hide_evidence.templateText: Make sure the vial is never found on you. If anyone searches you or your things, they come up empty.
hide_evidence.templateHint: #ownerName# is the killer. Award if the poison was never found on them or traced to them.

hide_evidence.templateText: Nobody connects you to the poison. End the night without a single guest able to say how it reached #victimName#'s glass.
hide_evidence.templateHint: #ownerName# is the killer. Award if no player correctly explained how #ownerName# delivered the poison.

hide_evidence.templateText: Account for your time. Have a story for every minute around #victimName#'s death, and get at least one guest to repeat it for you.
hide_evidence.templateHint: #ownerName# is the killer. Award if another player vouched for #ownerName#'s alibi.

hide_evidence.templateText: You were not as careful as you thought. Find out who noticed something about you tonight, without tipping your hand, and keep them from putting it together.
hide_evidence.templateHint: #ownerName# is the killer. Award if the trail facts held by other players were never combined in front of the group.

frame.templateText: Steer the group's suspicion toward #targetName#. They should be the one voted guilty.
frame.templateHint: #ownerName# is the killer and is framing #targetName#. Award if #targetName# was voted guilty.

frame.templateText: #targetName# had every reason to want #victimName# dead. Make sure the room knows it, and that the final vote lands on them.
frame.templateHint: #ownerName# is the killer and is framing #targetName#. Award if #targetName# was voted guilty.

frame.templateText: Put the poison on #targetName#: plant the idea, the motive, or the vial itself. They take the fall tonight.
frame.templateHint: #ownerName# is the killer and is framing #targetName#. Award if #targetName# was voted guilty.

frame.templateText: Let #targetName# hang for this. Feed their motive to the loudest guest in the room and let the vote do the rest.
frame.templateHint: #ownerName# is the killer and is framing #targetName#. Award if #targetName# was voted guilty.
